meta_description:
31K likes, 157 comments - beautifuldestinations on October 16, 2026: "China after dark deserves its own itinerary.

Shanghai’s skyline reflected in the river, Wangxian Valley glowing beneath the cliffs, and Chongqing’s buildings stacked high above streets full of neon. It’s worth leaving time to see these places twice, once during the day and again when the lights come on.

Spend an evening walking along the Bund in Shanghai, follow the illuminated paths through Wangxian Valley, or head to Hongya Cave in Chongqing for its layers of glowing balconies.

Keep a few evenings free rather than filling every day with early starts. Some of the views worth travelling for come after sunset.

📽️ Beautiful Destinations Original
📍 China".
